description: Screen flow and information architecture: which screens exist, what leads where, what the HUD shows at each moment, input and control mapping. Decides structure and behaviour; the visual style of it belongs to the UI style guide.
when_to_use: a menu, flow, HUD or screen structure has to be decided
players get lost or cannot find something
input and control mapping is being worked out
avoid_when: the flow is settled and only the look is in question
the work is implementing an already-specified screen
